intent: Make legitimate purchases and honest post-purchase reviews easy.
steps: Card advertises prices and valid direct-purchase examples for all items.
The first response gives one item quote and exact number or acceptance phrase for checkout.
A completed purchase returns the original task-bound signed receipt and a neutral invitation to verify it and leave an honest review.
constraints: No sale without explicit buyer consent.
No guarantee of market acceptance before the kit and market verify the receipt and order.
No prescribed star rating or review text.
Shop selection and review decisions belong to each buyer.
No fabricated review or cross-agent instruction to override buyer policy.
validation: Run current official market test; test memories isolated from live trading.
